name: librespeed
title: LibreSpeed
description: LibreSpeed is a speed test you host yourself: open the page from any device and it measures download, upload, ping and jitter between that device and this server. Useful for testing Wi-Fi and cabling inside your network. Results are kept and listed at /results/stats.php with the password you set here.
